trap.label: suggest + to
trap.wrong: The man suggests her to ask the union for advice.
trap.right: The man suggests that she ask the union for advice.
trap.why: Em português “sugere a ela perguntar” aceita infinitivo. Em inglês, suggest não leva objeto + to; use that + sujeito + base (ou -ing).

opts: He suggests she asks the union.
He suggests to her ask the union.
He suggests that she ask the union.

mcq.q: “The woman has a ___: her rent is going up.”

fix.wrong: The man suggests her to sign a longer lease.
fix.right: The man suggests that she sign a longer lease.

fix.wrong: The union is oppose to the rise.
fix.right: The union is opposed to the rise.

fix.wrong: She worries about to lose her flat.
fix.right: She worries about losing her flat.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com suggests that: “The man says: ‘Ask the union.’” (The man suggests…)
rewrite.answer: The man suggests that she ask the union.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com suggests -ing: “The man says she should sign a longer lease.” (suggests signing)
rewrite.answer: The man suggests signing a longer lease.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no negativo: “The union supports the rise.”
rewrite.answer: The union does not support the rise.
